repairs.reader: The two README sentences quoted whole (simplicity_iff … dedekind_rhs): these are very dense. Phrases such as "a single rung", "q = 3 by rfl", "independent of the Epstein premises" and "the family's carried at INTERFACES" are not explained.
repairs.new: (dedekind_rhs)." In these two sentences, as the kernel's own files read them: "a single rung" means that λ₁ > 0 is proved for the first of Li's coefficients alone, not for every n; "q = 3 by rfl" means that the statement at modulus q = 3 is the family theorem's statement by definition, which Lean checks by rfl, a proof by definitional equality; a result "carried at INTERFACES on" a named premise or obligation is compiled with that premise taken as a hypothesis and not proved (WHAT THE KERNELS ASSUME, below); "independent of the Epstein premises" means that the window family and its two obligations are statements about test functions alone and do not use EpsteinPremises, one of the open premises listed below; and "the family's" is the family's term of the right-hand side of dedekind_rhs, the term beside the trivial character's, carried on TrivialSummandPremise and EulerFactorPremise. repairs.new: The mechanism exclusions: three route terminals of SIDE-kernel at its tag v1.5 (commit 0e5233f; the kernel's own record, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21520474), each printed by #print axioms at v1.5 as [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] (relay data/b457_profile_run.txt). The first, structural_exhaustiveness_proved, is compiled and states three things, each proved: that the kernel's mechanism type has seven members, that none of them produces the off-line signature the kernel defines, and Ostrowski's classification of the places of the rationals. It does not state that the seven classes exhaust all mechanisms: the exhaustiveness of the seven classes over all mechanisms is the manuscript's theorem and is not compiled (ERRATA E-2026-09-14-1). The second is SpectralCannonFull.spectral_cannon. The third, ConservationBridge.riemann_hypothesis, concludes RH from its premise ConservationHypothesis, and a compiled ten-line lemma shows that premise to be RH restated (ERRATA E-2026-09-25-1), so that this theorem derives RH only from RH restated.

repairs.reader: The keystone census sum ("50 heads … summing to 123 … rule-elab rows beside sum to 47; 12 rows rest on a premise no head names … INTERFACES rows … number 186: rule 117, rule-elab 46, cell 23"): I could not see how these figures fit together.
repairs.new: cell 23." That is: the INTERFACES rows outside the upstream rows, 186 in all, are counted by where their grade comes from, 117 by the rule, 46 by the rule reading the elaborated type (rule-elab) and 23 by a ledger cell; the 50 heads are the named premises those rows rest on; a rule-graded row is counted once under each named premise it rests on, so one row can be counted more than once, and these counts over the 50 heads sum to 123; the same count over the rule-elab rows sums to 47; and 12 rows rest on a premise that none of the 50 heads names.
